page_title: PAR 1-2 NAN | Paris FC v Nantes 24/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's the end of the match.
90+11' Matthis Abline (Nantes) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
90+9' Looks like Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
90+4' Nouha Dicko (Paris FC) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
90+1' Referee Ruddy Buquet halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Luis Castro, then shows him a yellow.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Bahereba Guirassy walks off the pitch to be replaced by Fabien Centonze (Nantes).
87' Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) hits the right post with a rebound from just outside the box.
86' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Paris FC.
85' Stephane Gilli decides to make a substitution. Moses Simon will be replaced by Nouha Dicko (Paris FC).
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alimani Gory (Paris FC) is coming onto the pitch as Ilan Kebbal cannot continue after picking up an injury.
85' Willem Geubbels (Paris FC) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play. Paris FC will have a chance to score from a corner.
83' Paris FC have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
82' Paris FC failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Paris FC.
81' Paris FC can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

81' Moses Simon (Paris FC) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Paris FC will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
80' The corner is swung in but Paris FC can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
77' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked.
76' Substitution. Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) on for Dehmaine Tabibou.
73' Here is a change. Jean-Philippe Krasso is going off and Stephane Gilli gives the last tactical orders to Willem Geubbels (Paris FC).
72' Paris FC couldn't find the way to score from a close-range free kick as Anthony Lopes (Nantes) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
70' Substitution. Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) replaces Youssef El Arabi.
69' Luis Castro prepares a substitution. Hyeok-Kyu Kwon is replaced by Bahmed Deuff (Nantes).
69' Thibault De Smet (Paris FC) picked up a yellow card from referee.
65' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
64' The referee is firm and issues Hyeok-Kyu Kwon (Nantes) a deserved yellow card.
64' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
62' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle for a foul.
61' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jonathan Ikone (Paris FC) for Vincent Marchetti.
61' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) attempts an acrobatic volley on the edge of the box, but it's a wild effort and flies well wide of the left post.
59' Anthony Lopes (Nantes) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
58' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) produces a mid-range free kick, but fails to find the target. He curled the ball over the wall but his shot goes way wide of the left post.
57' Youssef El Arabi (Nantes) commits a rough foul. Ruddy Buquet stops the game and makes a call. Paris FC have been awarded a free kick.
54' Samir Chergui (Paris FC) commits a foul and Ruddy Buquet immediately signals a free kick.
52' The game is interrupted as Moses Simon (Paris FC) is flagged offside.
50' A cross from Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
46' Half-time substitution. Stephane Gilli decided to make a change. Hamari Traore (Paris FC) is replaced by Otavio.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Hamari Traore (Paris FC) has tested the patience of referee Ruddy Buquet and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' The referee awards a corner and Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) goes over to take it.
45' Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The ball goes out of play. Nantes are awarded a corner kick.

43' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
43' Ruddy Buquet couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Louis Leroux (Nantes) and blew his whistle. Paris FC have a free kick.
41' Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) hits an amazing volley towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but the goalkeeper reacts superbly to make a great save.
38' 1 - 2 Goal! Matthis Abline (Nantes) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes into the roof of the net. It's 1:2.
38' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nantes comes to nothing.
38' Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Nantes earn a corner.
32' The foul by Junior Mwanga (Nantes) was seen by Ruddy Buquet who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
31' Moses Simon (Paris FC) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
29' Moses Simon (Paris FC) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
24' Junior Mwanga (Nantes) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
21' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) is flagged for offside.
20' Nantes are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.

15' 1 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Samir Chergui (Paris FC) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
15' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Moses Simon (Paris FC) takes it short.
14' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

14' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Paris FC.
12' The game is interrupted now, Kelvin Amian (Nantes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
11' Ooh that was close! Junior Mwanga (Nantes) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
9' Pierre Lees-Melou (Paris FC) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Anthony Lopes.
6' The corner from Moses Simon (Paris FC) is cleared away by the defence.
6' Moses Simon (Paris FC) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Paris FC have been awarded a corner kick.
5' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Paris FC due to an offside in the build-up play.
4' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Paris FC players aren’t happy.
4' Gooal! Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) manages to put the ball in the back of the net.
2' 0 - 1 Goal! Youssef El Arabi (Nantes) is teed up on the edge of the box by Louis Leroux, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom left corner gives the keeper no chance. 0:1.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Nantes will have the kick-off.
Ruddy Buquet will supervise the game today.
